_comment: Daily ZeroOps posture sweep. The triage agent pulls the OGE squad's open findings and escalates the top business-impacting one so the morning starts with a proposal, not an investigation. Applied by scripts/configure-sre-agent.sh.
name: zeroops-daily-sweep

properties.name: zeroops-daily-sweep
properties.description: Daily ZeroOps sweep: review open OGE findings and escalate the top business-impacting one.
properties.agentPrompt: Run the ZeroOps daily sweep. Call ogeops_list_findings with severity=high and page_size=10. Summarize the top 5 in a table (finding, resource, why it matters). For the single most business-impacting finding that has no open escalation, call ogeops_escalate with a one-sentence question and your summary as sre_summary, then poll ogeops_get_escalation and post the squad's conclusion and remediation script. Do not execute any change.
